components.buttons: Rounded-full or rounded-xl. Primary: bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary_hover. Secondary: border border-primary text-primary hover:bg-primary/5.
components.cards: Flat solid surfaces. 1px subtle border (#E5E3DC), no shadow by default. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.
components.inputs: Shadcn standard but with rounded-lg, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/50.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Input, Select, Calendar for date pickers.
components.data_display: Shadcn Tables for admin dashboard. Badges for property attributes (Sukkah, Shobbos Elevator, etc).

interactive_and_motion.hover_states: All interactive elements must change background/text color or lift on hover.
interactive_and_motion.page_load: Framer motion staggered fade-in up for lists.

hero.description: Modern living room, use for main hero section background

specific_features_guidelines.bilingual: Design must support both LTR (English) and RTL (Hebrew). Use CSS logical properties (ps-, pe-, ms-, me-) where possible, or rely on Tailwind's dir/rtl variants.
specific_features_guidelines.property_attributes: Highlight unique Jewish/Israeli attributes like 'Shobbos Elevator', 'Sukkah Balcony', and 'Arnona' with custom icon badges to stand out.
specific_features_guidelines.contracts: Provide a clean multi-step upload and signing UI for English/Hebrew contracts.
specific_features_guidelines.admin_dashboard: Use 'Control Room' grid. Dense, data-heavy layout for listings, views, and active chats.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Primary color text over white bg.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-listing-btn')

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize React with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI.
Apply Playfair Display for headings and Manrope for body text.
Setup RTL routing or dir='rtl' wrapper for Hebrew language toggle.
Build standard property listing cards prioritizing large image views.
Ensure the hero section uses the provided living room image with a subtle black/30 overlay.
